goal: Relate a design revision to its analysis model and use evidence to select CAD, CAE or mapping-only changes
required_demonstrations: Versioned entity correspondence, coordinate frame, unit conversion, simplification and interface/load transfer
A user geometry edit invalidates only dependent results while preserving prior input snapshots
A CAE-only numerical-quality change reuses unchanged geometry with an explicit reason
An intentionally mismatched realized thickness is detected before interpreting results
A persistent backend job survives a fresh Codex chat without duplicate submission
At least one historical unit adopted and one limited/rejected with condition comparisons
A held-out change not enumerated by the skill causes Codex to generate or recombine candidates
environment_gate: Choose the held-out condition from the available task family and fix numerical limits, wall-clock budget and independent references before executing
